description: The spec leaves `data` optional on `WebhookResponse`, the envelope that createWebhook, getWebhook and updateWebhook return, while every other Mux response envelope requires it. Mux always sends it: createWebhook, getWebhook and updateWebhook on 2026-11-25 each returned `{"data": {"id": …, "address": …, "enabled": …, "created_at": …}}`.
